blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police operatives arrested on Monday two alleged New People’s Army (NPA) rebels listed among Surigao del Sur’s top wanted personalities during an operation in Tagbina town, a police official said. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, director of Police Regional Office 13 (Caraga), identified the suspects by their aliases “Kiami” or “Ivana,” 24, from Sitio Han-ayan, Barangay Diatagon, Lianga; and “Chez,” 25, who also goes by the monikers “Yenyen,” “Ykoy,” and “Mermer,” from Sitio Mike, also in Diatagon.
